  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02

  cores:
    kind: input

    value: 16

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  spare:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: 1 - utilisation
    formla: 1 - utilisation
